title: GEMSDOE67 — orientation/tip decoding and OVTR evidence lanes
description: DOE GEMS Prize Challenge repository published as parallel research lanes — orientation/tip decoding on `main`, orientation-voted evidence (OVTR), and an independent re-implementation of the orientation/tip brief — whose README tabulates each lane's own verdict: the OVTR lane is “DOWNLOAD READY” with measured HOLDOUT-DTI 0.2691 pooled (22/22 format checks), the orientation/tip lane is “NEGATIVE · DOWNLOAD BLOCKED” (0.0344 joint / 0.0404 segmentation control), and the independent re-implementation lane is “NEGATIVE · NO DOWNLOAD OFFERED”. The README states the negative lanes agree in outcome and that no competition slot has been used by any lane. The configured Pages root is a meta-refresh hand-off to the docs/ submission page. The directory repeats the repository's own wording and makes no independent claim about any artifact or score.
